issue.desc: Save .json files in Schema 3.
Restrict the EDIT control for positive integer items to prevent entering decimals and minus signs.
Remove '7: Enable switch' in I/O allocation/safety input.
Restrict the signal value range based on the signal type on the Replan page.
Restrict the input format for CIP safety SNN.
Restrict input values for Default I/O and additional I/O to multiples of 10 only.
Add validation for FuncNo+Subset and duplicate check for I/O Allocation.
Fix the issue where icons appear small on high DPI monitors.
[MOD] I/O Allocation - Change the subset numbering in the I/O Function List to start from #0 instead of #1.
[MOD] I/O Allocation - Exclude Safety Output & Safety Communication Output from duplicate checks.
[MOD] I/O Allocation - For input 297 and output 218, which are the last function numbers in the I/O Function List, only subset 0 is allowed.

[FIX] Fix an issue with the legacy schema0 encryption scheme Hi7 where, after setting a password using HRSafeSpace2 while no password was configured, subsequent password verification or password changes were incorrectly treated as a password mismatch.
[ADD] CIP Safety - Display the Ethernet IP address of the remote device.
[FIX] CIP Safety - Fix an issue that allowed FFFF_FFFF_FFFG to be entered as the SNN.
[FIX] I/O Allocation - Improve the duplicate-checking function, and insert some item.
[MOD] Allow downloads only in the Emergency Stop (or Simulator) state.
[ADD] Add keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+N, Ctrl+O, Ctrl+S).
[ADD] Enable the OK action with the ENTER key in the password dialog.
[ADD] Add `Tool - Initialize Current Page`.
[FIX] In the HTML report, update index and remove 2 deprecated replan items.
[FIX] Coordinate values higher than 3200 in layout/space/area are distorted.
